$comment: QADLC Claude Code settings. Hooks are advisory except the Stop hook, which enforces the plan-approval gate and checkbox discipline. Paths are relative to the project root; Claude Code runs them with bun. Every hook is wrapped in qadlc-preflight.sh, which execs straight through when bun is present (stdout and exit status pass untouched, so the Stop hook's decision:block still reaches the harness). When bun is missing, SessionStart reports it once per session (--brief) and the per-turn hooks stay silent (--quiet) rather than emitting four 'command not found' errors on every edit in a repo whose owner may not be running QADLC at all.
